There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.55 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with three NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-63°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.64 Å.
